proof.text: Directedness makes all structure-map composites into p equal. Use their common value to give p its presheaf O-module structure; the Under identities and hι identify its sheafified structure map with σ.

The sectionwise ring colimit hypothesis hp gives stage representatives and eventual equality. Descend a compatible family of O-linear maps on representatives; a common upper bound proves additivity and linearity. Uniqueness proves compatibility with restriction, giving the presheaf module colimit.

Module sheafification preserves that colimit. Compare ring and module sheafifications through their underlying abelian sheafification; local representatives prove O-linearity and hι identifies the legs. Transport the colimit along the resulting cocone isomorphism.
